events.description: Planted root cause: a simulated bad config deploy increased OrderService timeout from 500ms to 2000ms, causing cascading latency. Telemetry shows the anomaly clearly; tickets appear ~3 min later — an early-warning window the agent can detect.

Perception blind spot: a frontend-side timeout misconfiguration causes user-visible errors that are not reflected in backend telemetry. Tickets arrive but no anomaly is recorded — the agent's blind-spot query should surface this.
